ex.en: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
ex.zh: 你必須在五點前到車站。

ex.en: This shop is open from 9 to 6 o'clock.
ex.zh: 這家店從九點營業到六點。

ex.en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
ex.zh: 他們約好七點在這裡碰面。

o'clock.en: used after a number from one to twelve to give the exact hour

ex.en: What is your occupation?
ex.zh: 你從事什麼工作？

ex.en: What's your occupation?
ex.zh: 您的職業是什麼？

ex.en: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.
ex.zh: 我喜歡畫油畫，但不打算把它當成一輩子的職業。

ex.en: The building is ready for occupation next month.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓下個月就可以進駐了。

ex.en: The city was under military occupation for years.
ex.zh: 這座城市被軍隊佔領了好幾年。

occupation.en: the act of taking control of a place by force, or of living in a building

occupant.zh: 居住者、使用者；（車內）乘客

ex.en: The previous occupant left the apartment very clean.
ex.zh: 前一位住戶把公寓留得很乾淨。

ex.en: All occupants must leave the building during the fire drill.
ex.zh: 消防演習時，所有人員都必須離開大樓。

occupant.en: a person who lives in a place or sits in a vehicle

ex.en: This is a daily occurrence.
ex.zh: 這種事每天都會發生。

ex.en: Power outages are a rare occurrence here.
ex.zh: 這裡很少停電。

ex.en: Delays are a common occurrence during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段延誤是常有的事。

occurrence.en: something that happens, or the fact of it happening

ex.en: I have occasional pains in the stomach.
ex.zh: 我的胃偶爾會痛。

ex.en: Even superheroes need an occasional break.
ex.zh: 就連超級英雄也需要偶爾休息一下。

ex.en: Today's weather is sunny with occasional clouds.
ex.zh: 今天天氣晴時多雲。

occasional.en: happening sometimes but not often or regularly

ex.en: When the big earthquake occurred, I was just ten.
ex.zh: 大地震發生時，我才十歲。

ex.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。

ex.en: Nobody knows when the earthquake will occur.
ex.zh: 沒有人知道地震何時會發生。

ex.en: A good idea occurred to me last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚想到一個好點子。

ex.en: It never occurred to me that he was lying.
ex.zh: 我從沒想過他在說謊。

ex.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
ex.zh: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。

ex.en: On gift-giving occasions, people generally avoid giving money, but there are exceptions.
ex.zh: 在送禮的場合，人們通常避免送錢，但也有例外。

ex.en: This dress is perfect for any occasion.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝適合任何場合。

ex.en: I'd like to take this occasion to thank our team.
ex.zh: 我想藉這個機會感謝我們的團隊。

ex.en: On one occasion, he left his passport at the hotel.
ex.zh: 有一次，他把護照忘在飯店。

occasion.en: one time when something happens, or a good chance to do something

ex.en: Books occupy most of his room.
ex.zh: 書佔了他房間的大部分空間。

ex.en: The meeting room is occupied at the moment.
ex.zh: 會議室現在有人在用。

ex.en: The house is not occupied now.
ex.zh: 這間房子目前沒人住。

occupy.en: to fill a space or time, or to live in a place

ex.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.
ex.zh: 這座城市很快就被士兵佔領了。

ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
ex.zh: 軍隊佔領了整個領土。

occupy.en: to take control of a place using force

ex.en: She occupied herself with work all weekend.
ex.zh: 她整個週末都忙著工作。

ex.en: The game kept the kids occupied for hours.
ex.zh: 那個遊戲讓孩子們玩了好幾個小時。

occupy.en: to keep someone busy or give their mind something to do

ex.en: He likes going to the beach occasionally.
ex.zh: 他喜歡偶爾去海邊走走。

ex.en: Dick is occasionally late to school.
ex.zh: 迪克偶爾會上學遲到。

ex.en: He occasionally reads detective novels.
ex.zh: 他偶爾會看偵探小說。

ex.en: The Pacific is the largest ocean in the world.
ex.zh: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。

ex.en: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
ex.zh: 海底有沙子。

ex.en: He crossed the Pacific Ocean in thirty days.
ex.zh: 他花了 30 天橫渡太平洋。

ocean.en: a very large area of salt water

ex.en: Hotel occupancy reached 90% during the holiday.
ex.zh: 連假期間飯店入住率達到九成。

ex.en: Office occupancy is still low after the pandemic.
ex.zh: 疫情過後，辦公室的使用率仍然偏低。

occupancy.en: the share of rooms or space that people are using

ex.en: The building is ready for occupancy.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓已經可以入住了。

ex.en: Maximum occupancy of this room is 50 people.
ex.zh: 這個房間最多容納 50 人。

occupancy.en: the act of living in or using a building

ex.en: Back pain is a common occupational problem for office workers.
ex.zh: 背痛是上班族常見的職業病。

ex.en: The company offers occupational safety training.
ex.zh: 公司提供職業安全訓練。

ex.en: The weather gets cooler in October.
ex.zh: 十月的天氣開始變涼。

ex.en: Our school sports day is in October.
ex.zh: 我們學校的運動會在十月。

ex.en: Halloween is on the last day of October.
ex.zh: 萬聖節在十月的最後一天。

ex.en: Sorry, this seat is occupied.
ex.zh: 抱歉，這個座位有人了。

ex.en: The bathroom door was locked, so I knew it was occupied.
ex.zh: 洗手間的門鎖著，所以我知道裡面有人。

ex.en: She was fully occupied with her homework all evening.
ex.zh: 她整個晚上都在忙著寫作業。

ex.en: I'm occupied at the moment, can I call you back?
ex.zh: 我現在正忙，可以晚點回電給你嗎？

ex.en: The occupied territory was returned after the war.
ex.zh: 被佔領的土地在戰後歸還了。

ex.en: Life was hard for people in the occupied city.
ex.zh: 被佔領城市裡的人民生活艱困。

ex.en: The occupier of the flat was asked to leave by the owner.
ex.zh: 房東要求公寓的住戶搬離。

ex.en: The house has been without an occupier for years.
ex.zh: 這間房子已經多年沒有人住了。

ex.en: The singer can reach a full octave higher than most people.
ex.zh: 這位歌手能唱到比一般人高整整一個八度。

ex.en: Play the same note one octave lower.
ex.zh: 把同一個音降低一個八度彈奏。

ex.en: The island has a mild oceanic climate with plenty of rain.
ex.zh: 這座島有溫和多雨的海洋性氣候。

ex.en: Scientists are studying oceanic currents to understand the weather.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究洋流以了解天氣。

ex.en: An octopus has eight arms and no bones.
ex.zh: 章魚有八隻觸手，而且沒有骨頭。

ex.en: We saw an octopus hiding in a rock at the aquarium.
ex.zh: 我們在水族館看到一隻章魚躲在石頭裡。

ex.en: He is fascinated by occult books about ancient rituals.
ex.zh: 他對關於古老儀式的神祕學書籍很著迷。

ex.en: The film is about a strange occult society.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一個怪異的神祕組織。

ex.en: She has studied the occult since she was a teenager.
ex.zh: 她從十幾歲起就在研究神祕學。

ex.en: Many old legends are linked to the occult.
ex.zh: 許多古老傳說都與神祕學有關。

ex.en: The garden has an octagonal pavilion in the middle.
ex.zh: 花園中央有一座八角形的涼亭。

ex.en: A stop sign is octagonal and usually red.
ex.zh: 停止標誌是八角形的，而且通常是紅色。

occupying.zh: 佔據；佔用（occupy 的現在分詞）

ex.en: A large sofa is occupying most of the living room.
ex.zh: 一張大沙發佔掉了客廳的大部分空間。

ex.en: Two students were occupying the seats I reserved.
ex.zh: 有兩個學生佔了我保留的座位。

occupying.zh: 使忙碌；使從事（occupy 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is occupying herself with gardening these days.
ex.zh: 她這幾天忙著打理花園。

ex.en: Playing games kept him occupying his time during the long trip.
ex.zh: 玩遊戲讓他在漫長的旅程中打發時間。
